items.text: Time is running out! Today is the LAST DAY to #GetCovered with an affordable health plan. If you haven't enrolled in a health insurance plan yet, don’t forget to visit https://t.co/2tc34oqdZs, where 4 out of 5 Americans can find coverage for $10 a month or less. https://t.co/l6LpFbQYNf

Last week, @POTUS announced that Medicare has begun negotiating with drug companies for lower drug prices, thanks to the #InflationReductionAct.

It's the first step in ensuring Americans have access to the drugs they need at prices they can afford--a historic milestone!

Under the #ACA, insurers must cover birth control, yet women are still having to fight to obtain it.

Women should make health care decisions with their doctors, not battle insurers. That's why the @DemWomenCaucus and I are calling on insurance providers to comply with the law. https://t.co/dyb8CKHPRo

Since @POTUS took office, he’s made seniors a top priority.
 
Thanks to the #InflationReductionAct, Medicare is now able to negotiate lower drug prices, providing over half a million older Floridians with access to affordable life-saving medications—a historic milestone! #SOTU

In 3 years, @POTUS has:
 
✅ Delivered historic job growth
✅ Revolutionized our infrastructure
✅ Boosted American manufacturing
✅ Supported our Veterans
✅ Protected Medicare, Medicaid, & Social Security
✅ Lowered prescription drug prices
 
A country for all Americans! #SOTU

.@POTUS' budget builds on the progress we’ve already made with more policies to:
1️⃣ Grow our economy,
2️⃣ lower everyday costs,
3️⃣ support working families,
4️⃣ protect Social Security & Medicare,
5️⃣ and reduce our deficit by making the wealthy pay their fair share.

Republicans' budget plan for next year proposes cuts to Medicare and Social Security, increases the costs of prescription drugs, energy, and housing, and even raises the SS retirement age!

I'm committed to protecting these vital programs and putting #PeopleOverPolitics.

I’m proud to fight for lowering health care costs for seniors in #PBC!

Thanks to @POTUS's Investing in America agenda & the #InflationReductionAct, seniors on Medicare are now seeing their insulin capped at $35/month, saving them an average of $440 a year—that's real savings! https://t.co/TOkLWb3c7p

Thanks to @POTUS & @HouseDemocrats’ #InflationReductionAct, over 10 million Medicare enrollees received recommended vaccines in 2023 at no cost!

If you have Medicare with drug coverage, you might be eligible this year too! Visit https://t.co/jtfnvyiIgp for more info.

Our kids are our future. Social Security and Medicare are essential benefits that our seniors have worked and paid for.

Democrats delivering!

President Biden is cementing a legacy of tremendous wins for seniors!

More savings for our seniors are on the way!
